<text:style bold="true">Constraints</text:style>

<image:base64 col="0" width="30" wrap="none"></image:base64>

A constraint is a rule that the drawing keeps: when something is moved, the rest
follows as little as it needs to, so that the rule still holds. Select the elements
(points by their handles, sides by clicking on them, Shift+click for more), then
press the button. Each button is active only when the elements selected are of the
right number and kind (for each of them it is said below which ones); otherwise it
is grayed. No constraint can be added while something is being drawn, and the points
of a path made of commands cannot take constraints. A small tag near the object
shows the constraints it has; the list is in the properties, where each one can be
deleted. When a constraint is added, the first element chosen is the reference and
the second one is the one that moves.

<image:base64 col="0" width="6" wrap="left"></image:base64><text:style bold="true">Fix</text:style>
Locks the selected points or objects: they cannot be moved. Select one or
more objects or points.<text:style bold="true"> Active when:</text:style> at least one object or point is
       selected.

<image:base64 col="0" width="6" wrap="left"></image:base64><text:style bold="true">Coincident</text:style>
Makes points coincide, or circles and ellipses share the centre. Select two
or more points or centres.<text:style bold="true"> Active when:</text:style> two or more points (or centres of
       circles) are selected.

<image:base64 col="0" width="6" wrap="left"></image:base64><text:style bold="true">Mid point</text:style>
Keeps a point at the middle of a line. Select a point and a line.<text:style bold="true"> Active</text:style>
<text:style bold="true">when:</text:style> a point and a line are selected.

<image:base64 col="0" width="6" wrap="left"></image:base64><text:style bold="true">Equal length</text:style>
Makes lines or sides all of the same length. Select two or more of them.<text:style bold="true"></text:style>
<text:style bold="true">Active when:</text:style> two or more lines or sides are selected.

<image:base64 col="0" width="6" wrap="left"></image:base64><text:style bold="true">Tangent</text:style>
Makes a line tangent to a circle, or two circles tangent to each other.
Select a line and a circle, or two circles.<text:style bold="true"> Active when:</text:style> a line and a circle
       are selected, or two circles.

<image:base64 col="0" width="6" wrap="left"></image:base64><text:style bold="true">Horizontal</text:style>
Makes a line or a side horizontal, or two points at the same height. Select
one line or two points.<text:style bold="true"> Active when:</text:style> one line or side is selected, or exactly
       two points.

<image:base64 col="0" width="6" wrap="left"></image:base64><text:style bold="true">Perpendicular</text:style>
Makes two lines or sides perpendicular. Select two of them.<text:style bold="true"> Active when:</text:style>
exactly two lines or sides are selected.

<image:base64 col="0" width="6" wrap="left"></image:base64><text:style bold="true">Same radius</text:style>
Gives the same radius to circles and ellipses. Select two or more of them.<text:style bold="true"></text:style>
<text:style bold="true">Active when:</text:style> two or more circles or ellipses are selected.

<image:base64 col="0" width="6" wrap="left"></image:base64><text:style bold="true">Intersection</text:style>
Keeps a point on one or two lines (on the crossing if they are two). Select a
point and the line or lines.<text:style bold="true"> Active when:</text:style> a point and one line are selected,
       or a point and two lines.

<image:base64 col="0" width="6" wrap="left"></image:base64><text:style bold="true">Parallel</text:style>
Makes two lines or sides parallel. Select two of them.<text:style bold="true"> Active when:</text:style> exactly
two lines or sides are selected.

<image:base64 col="0" width="6" wrap="left"></image:base64><text:style bold="true">Vertical</text:style>
Makes a line or a side vertical, or two points on the same vertical. Select
one line or two points.<text:style bold="true"> Active when:</text:style> one line or side is selected, or exactly
       two points.

The tags of the constraints can be hidden for a layer with the option "Hide
constraints tags" in the layers panel; the constraints keep working.
